Checks.Title: Correct aircraft connected
Checks.Instruction: Confirm the tail number / airframe ID of the connected vehicle matches the mission and paperwork for this flight. Note the aircraft ID below - it is recorded as this run's aircraft identity.

Checks.Title: Display units configured correctly
Checks.Instruction: Confirm distance/altitude/speed units shown in Mission Planner match your operating procedure.

Checks.Title: Mission is loaded and not empty
Battery status visible and acceptable
Checks.Instruction: Confirm the displayed battery percentage/voltage is acceptable for this flight.

Checks.Title: GPS/EKF status visible and healthy
Checks.Instruction: Confirm GPS fix (3D or better) and EKF status shown are healthy before continuing.

Checks.Title: Walkaround: nose section
Checks.Instruction: Check nose structure, pitot/static area, antennas and fasteners. Record any defect in the notes.

Checks.Title: Walkaround: fuselage and tail
Checks.Instruction: Check fuselage skin, access panels, tail structure and control horns for damage or loose fasteners.

Checks.Title: Walkaround: wings and control surfaces
Checks.Instruction: Check wing structure, control surface hinges and linkages for damage, play or obstruction.

Checks.Title: Walkaround: landing gear
Checks.Instruction: Check landing gear/skids for damage and secure attachment.

Checks.Title: Commanded surface movement: aileron
Checks.Instruction: Aircraft disarmed. Move the aileron stick left, then right. Confirm each aileron moves the correct direction, moves smoothly and returns to neutral.

Checks.Title: Commanded surface movement: elevator
Checks.Instruction: Aircraft disarmed. Move the elevator stick up, then down. Confirm the elevator moves the correct direction, moves smoothly and returns to neutral.

Checks.Title: Commanded surface movement: rudder
Checks.Instruction: Aircraft disarmed. Move the rudder stick left, then right. Confirm the rudder moves the correct direction, moves smoothly and returns to neutral.

Checks.Title: Payload and battery secured
Checks.Instruction: Confirm payload and flight battery are correctly seated and secured, with no possibility of shifting in flight.

Checks.Title: Propeller/rotor area clear
Checks.Instruction: Confirm propeller/rotor discs are clear of obstructions, tools and people before arming.
